core.headline: Extended 1930s semi-detached house in Sevenoaks, Kent
core.listing:
A semi-detached house in Oak Lane, Sevenoaks, extended in 2021 to create a kitchen/family room measuring 7.80m x 5.10m max (25'7" x 16'9" max) with an island, bi-fold doors and underfloor heating. The loft was converted in 2019 to form a fourth bedroom with en-suite, supported by a building regulations completion certificate.

The sitting room measures 4.55m x 3.70m into bay (14'11" x 12'2" into bay) and is fitted with a log burner. A separate dining room measures 3.60m x 3.40m (11'10" x 11'2"). The former garage has been converted to a ground-floor utility room and shower room. The front door and hall window retain original stained-glass panels.

The principal bedroom measures 4.20m x 3.60m (13'9" x 11'10"). The loft bedroom measures 5.20m x 3.30m max (17'1" x 10'10" max) and benefits from the en-suite. A family bathroom serves the other two bedrooms.

The south-west-facing rear garden extends approx. 30m (100ft) and includes a patio and a garden office with power. A driveway provides parking for two cars.

Sevenoaks station is approx. 0.8 miles away, with trains to London Bridge taking approx. 25 minutes. Sevenoaks School and Knole Park are nearby.

Guide Price £975,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band F (Sevenoaks District Council). EPC rating D. Construction: standard – brick and render under a clay-tiled roof. Electricity, water (metered) and sewerage are mains-connected. Gas central heating; underfloor heating in kitchen/family room. FTTP broadband up to 900Mbps. Good indoor and outdoor mobile signal. Driveway for two cars. The 2021 rear extension was built with planning permission.
